description.p: WaveFlow is a local-first music player for Windows, macOS and Linux. It scans your music folders, organizes everything by album, artist and genre, and plays it through its own real-time audio engine. No account, no subscription, no streaming service: your music stays on your machine.

ul.li: Hi-Res and bit-perfect playback: exclusive output on every system, native DSD over DoP, 5.1 and 7.1 on the right speakers
Gapless playback, crossfades and AutoMix on the beat, ReplayGain, a 6-band equalizer, speed with or without keeping the pitch
MP3, FLAC, ALAC, AAC, Ogg Vorbis, Opus, WavPack, Monkey's Audio, WAV, AIFF and DSD
Lyrics synced word by word, with romanization and translations, a lyrics editor and a floating desktop window
Smart playlists, Daily Mix, On Repeat and Release Radar, and playlist import from M3U, CSV and JSON
Tempo, key and loudness analysis, a Quality tab that flags likely fake lossless files, duplicates and album completeness
MusicBrainz enrichment and a tag workshop, both with an undo
Six skins and fourteen themes, an immersive view, a mini-player, statistics and a yearly Wrapped
Podcasts, WebDAV and SMB shares, Last.fm and ListenBrainz, DLNA and MPD servers, sandboxed plugins
17 languages, a separate library per profile, automatic backups

Unified player-bar layout panel with EQ presets and configurable cover-click action
Mini-player remembers position and size across launches

Wrapped banner gated to the December–January season with per-year dismiss

description.p: Settings split into category tabs, multi-step onboarding wizard with language picker, profile delete + rename, persistent zoom with VS Code shortcuts, and a host of library/UI polish.
Stability fixes across the library scanner, playback engine and theme system.
